2146-3693-4659-5224.description:

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.

579-2366-5702-8296.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2226-5125-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-5125-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sparkcaster by paying its mana cost.
When Sparkcaster enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

Use Iroh to give Blightbeetle to an opponent

When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.

5776-5777-7627.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
5776-5777-7627.description:

Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Mushroom Watchdogs ability
Repeat.

Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-5789-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.

When Old-Growth Educator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Old-Growth Educator enters, it triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2043-3621-3698.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

140-3967-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
140-3967-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've lost X or more life this turn.
140-3967-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
140-3967-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

5330-6972-7154.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

2097-4682-5140-6441.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
2097-4682-5140-6441.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Jolene and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
2097-4682-5140-6441.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

57-3094-4846-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.

Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4013-4659-5004-6643-6967.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.

When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping the land with Squirrel Nest attached.

1479-4826-5700-5701-6517.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4826-5700-5701-6517.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

394-856-997-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
394-856-997-4321.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1074-4222-6441.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping King Macar.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling target creature and creating two Gold artifact tokens.
Activate the Golds by sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat as desired.
You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.

56-443-5256-6112.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Magus of the Bridge and Fumulus trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-443-5256-6112.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

3470-4772-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3470-4772-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3470-4772-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra each trigger twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.

When Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {U}{B}.

Pemmin's Aura attached to Vhal.

1887-2060-2122-4279.description:

Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.

Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.

914-3352-5256.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3352-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dockside Extortionist's power.
Cast Disturbed Burial for its buyback cost by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Dockside Extortionist for {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of artifacts and enchantments your opponent control.
Activate seven of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{R}.
Repeat.

360-413-1981.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
